reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Employment
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence has revolutionized various industries by automating routine tasks and improving efficiency. While some worry that AI will eliminate jobs, evidence suggests that new positions are created in AI development, maintenance, and oversight. Throughout history, technological advances have initially disrupted labor markets but ultimately generated more employment opportunities. Workers must adapt by developing skills in areas where human creativity and emotional intelligence remain irreplaceable. Companies investing in AI should simultaneously invest in workforce retraining programs to ensure smooth transitions.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about the relationship between AI and employment?
options: AI will completely eliminate all jobs
AI creates both challenges and new opportunities
AI has no significant impact on the job market
Only routine workers will be affected
questions.explanation: 문단에서 AI가 일자리를 없애는 것은 아니며 새로운 직업이 창출된다고 제시하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the passage, what skills should workers develop?
questions.explanation: 문단의 마지막 부분에서 인간의 창의성과 감정 지능이 중요하다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What action does the passage recommend for companies?
options: Invest in retraining programs alongside AI
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 기업이 AI 투자와 함께 직원 재교육 프로그램에 투자해야 한다고 권장하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: Remote work is more productive than working in a traditional office?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시 (동의 또는 반대). 이유를 간단히 언급하며 에세이 방향 제시
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이유 설명. 구체적인 예시나 증거 제시로 주장 강화
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 이유 설명. 반대 의견을 인정하면서도 자신의 입장 재강조
structure.conclusion: 주요 포인트 요약. 최종 의견 재확인 및 미래 전망 제시

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work offers significant advantages such as
Furthermore, the flexibility of working from home allows employees to
Some people argue that office collaboration is essential; however,
In conclusion, the benefits of remote work outweigh the drawbacks because
One major advantage is that remote workers can avoid commuting time

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer learning new skills through online courses. Others prefer traditional classroom education. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer online courses because they offer flexibility
One reason is that online learning allows me to study at my own pace
Another advantage is that I can access various resources and expert instructors from around the world
Although some people believe classroom learning is more effective, I think online education provides better accessibility
sample_points: 온라인 코스의 유연성: 자신의 일정에 맞춰 학습할 수 있으며 반복 학습 가능
비용 효율성: 전통 교실보다 저렴하고 이동 시간이 없어 효율적인 학습 환경 제공

listening.title: Sustainable Urban Planning
listening.script: Professor: Today we'll discuss sustainable urban planning. Modern cities face challenges like traffic congestion and pollution. Urban planners now focus on creating green spaces, improving public transportation, and designing walkable neighborhoods. In Copenhagen, the government invested in bicycle infrastructure, reducing car dependency significantly. Similarly, Singapore integrated parks into residential areas, improving air quality and residents' well-being. These strategies require initial investment but generate long-term benefits including lower healthcare costs and increased property values. Successful sustainable cities balance economic growth with environmental protection through innovative design and community engagement. When residents feel involved in planning decisions, they're more likely to support and maintain these green initiatives. The future of urban development depends on such forward-thinking approaches.

questions.q: What is the professor's main focus in this discussion?
options: Sustainable urban planning strategies and examples
questions.explanation: 교수는 지속 가능한 도시 계획의 전략과 코펜하겐, 싱가포르의 구체적인 사례를 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the passage, what was the effect of Copenhagen's bicycle infrastructure investment?
questions.explanation: 강의에서 코펜하겐의 자전거 인프라 투자가 자동차 의존성을 크게 줄였다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Why does the professor mention community engagement?
options: To show that residents oppose green initiatives
To demonstrate that community involvement increases support for sustainable projects
questions.explanation: 주민이 계획 과정에 참여하면 이러한 녹색 계획을 더 지지하고 유지할 가능성이 높다고 설명하고 있습니다.
